ports.vegetation: Seeded tree/grass candidate generation in FPSWorld; authored roads/hydrology preparation remains script. RNG is tile-local; terrain configuration readonly during workers.
ports.audio: FPSAudio grass eligibility/distance/cadence history plus cached FPSWorld grass contact cells; spatial source pruning, physics visibility rays, attenuation/filter updates and room probes in C++. Script retains actor-state gathering, resource loading and playback. Audio scene access restricted to owner thread.
ports.buildings: FPSWorld cached bounds/LOD hysteresis/frustum/distance selection and packed MultiMesh transforms; refreshed on destruction patches and round restore. Script retains scene setup/GPU buffer submission.
ports.prediction: FPSMovement bounded insertion-ordered sample history, acknowledgement guard, error/impulse calculations, contact filtering, pruning and pending-state shifts. Script retains actor lifecycle, stance/jetpack reconciliation and applying corrections. Diagnostics use explicit snapshots; network fast path uses native history size.

fixture_adjustments: Tree candidate comparison now allows the same <0.01 m terrain-height tolerance as native terrain sampling. Seeded kind/scale/angle remain exact. Observed maximum tree position difference 0.0000152587890625 m, grass rows exact.

Field ambience fixture no longer requires volume above -20 dB; existing authored river level is -21 dB. It checks river proximity and an unmuted source. Production ambience unchanged.
